When an I/O error occurs during an intermediate commit on a rolling

column2: xfs_trans_commit() will free the transaction structure

column1: gets used as the transaction continues still contains a pointer
to the ticket. Hence when the duplicate transaction is cancelled

column2: we free the ticket a second time.

column1: Add reference counting to the ticket so that we hold an extra
reference to the ticket over the transaction commit. We drop the
extra reference once we have checked that the transaction commit

column2: thus avoiding a double free on commit
